lines.speaker: Kelsier
lines.text: Mind your head on the way in. Seven thousand men sleep in these caverns, and every one of them snores.

lines.speaker: Vin
lines.text: Seven thousand? Down here, all this time, and the obligators never smelled the smoke?

lines.speaker: Kelsier
lines.text: Smoke goes up through cracks a mile wide. The hard part wasn't hiding them. It was convincing them to stay.

lines.speaker: Kelsier
lines.text: Walk the yard. Talk to Ham. See what the crew has been paying for — then tell me honestly whether they're ready.
